name: Yatra Anudan
benefit: - The Council provides travel grants to researchers and scientists to participate in international scientific workshops and other similar programs. - Under this scheme, 50% of the travel expenses (up to a maximum of ₹25,000/-) are provided to researchers and scientists of the state.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a researcher or scientist.
